description: This file defines a singleton object 'DeviceNames' that provides a method to determine the best default device name for Android devices, primarily used in network or device identification within the application.

classes.name: DeviceNames
classes.description: Singleton object providing device naming logic for Android devices.

methods.name: bestDefaultNodeName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly device name, preferring a stored device name if available, otherwise constructing from manufacturer and model, defaulting to "Android Node".
